meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会对代码进行深度安全审计，包括 OWASP Top 10 检查、硬编码密钥扫描、依赖漏洞检测等，并生成审计报告。
howto.when: 当你输入 /security-audit 命令，或指定目录如 /security-audit src/auth/ 时触发。

say.text: 对 src/payments/ 做安全审计。
say.note: Claude 会审计该目录并生成报告。
Claude 会审计整个 src/ 目录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude performs a deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, hardcoded secrets, dependency vulnerabilities, and more, then writes a report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type /security-audit or /security-audit <path> (e.g., /security-audit src/auth/).

say_en.note: Claude audits that directory and generates a report.
Claude audits the entire src/ directory.
